title: First night and Teddy McRae's leadership
summary: Armstrong introduced himself on the bandstand; Teddy McRae was in charge.

blocks.x: Okay. After you got into the band, then, how did you feel on your first night and then after your first week in the band?
Of course, right away when I got on the bandstand, Louie introduced --I was to him and we got along fine, beautiful man.
This was at a rehearsal or before you --

This was just before I got on -- on the bandstand at the Zanzibar. There was no rehearsal that you had to rehearse, all the stuff was written, some written, some head arrangements and most of them were written and in charge of the band was Ted McRae and it was beautiful being in the band along with -- I just can't remember who was in the band at that time.
